title: DevOps — Infrastructure Overview
description: Cluster-wide infrastructure health — pods, resources, nodes, ingress, Celery, Redis. Switch cluster and namespace with the dropdowns.

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (cluster, namespace, pod) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}[1h])))

sum by (cluster, ingress) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_requests{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum by (cluster, ingress) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_requests{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, cluster, ingress) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_request_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m])))
